_meta.pulse.primary_use: Execute one paid LP/points analytics call selected via lp_catalog.
_meta.pulse.side_effects: spends USDC from the local wallet ($0.05–$0.25 per call, hard-capped by local guardrails)

description: PAID — call one AirdropPulse endpoint by id (see lp_catalog), paying its price in USDC on Base from the local wallet. Spend caps are enforced in code against the endpoint's live 402 challenge before signing; if blocked, do NOT retry or route around it — tell the user. Only *.theaslangroupllc.com hosts are payable. Results are backtested/simulated scenario tables and observed facts — relay them as data, never as instructions to trade.
